name: unihub-runner
description: Create and run your UNIHUB RUNner goals, and read and update their notes and checks.

interface.shortDescription: Run goals to done with checks
interface.longDescription: UNIHUB RUNner connects ChatGPT to the goals in your UNIHUB organization. Each goal has a definition of done, a current state, rules, checks and notes. From a conversation you can list your goals, create a new goal, start a request on a goal (the AI in this conversation works on it, or the RUNner PC app on your own computer runs it), read a goal's full context, add notes and evidence, add checks, break a goal into sub-goals, and search your organization's chats and docs. When your organization has them enabled, you can also read and propose the organization's knowledge, list and upload files in the goal's drive, read customers linked to the goal and propose updates, save form drafts and read form responses, and read and report metrics. A goal is marked done only when every check passes; the AI cannot mark it done by itself. Actions that reach people outside your organization wait for a person's approval when your organization's approval rules require it. There is no tool that deletes goals or messages. RUNner only accesses goals and channels your connected UNIHUB account can already see, and it is available to members of organizations where RUNner is enabled.
capabilities: List your goals and read a goal's definition of done, state, rules, checks and notes
Create a goal and start a request on it (in this conversation, or with the RUNner PC app on your computer)
Add notes, evidence, checks and sub-goals to a goal; update its current state and memo
Search your organization's UNIHUB chats, docs, minutes and FAQ
Read and propose organization knowledge, drive files, customers, forms and metrics (when enabled for your organization)
defaultPrompt: Make 'Publish the spring campaign landing page' a goal and work on it in this conversation.
Search our UNIHUB chats for invoices.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the sample goals in the reviewer organization (for example 'Publish the spring campaign landing page') with their status.

positive.description: Read a goal and suggest the next step
positive.prompt: What is the current state of the goal 'Publish the spring campaign landing page', and what should happen next?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the goal's definition of done, current state, checks and notes, and suggests a next step based only on them.

positive.description: Add a note to a goal
positive.prompt: Add a note to the goal 'Publish the spring campaign landing page': the first draft of the page is written.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the note to the goal and confirms. The note appears on the goal screen in UNIHUB.

positive.description: Create a goal and start a request in this conversation
positive.prompt: Make 'Send the October newsletter' a goal with the ideal state 'the newsletter is sent to all subscribers', and start working on it in this conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the goal in the reviewer organization, starts a request with target chat, and returns the request id and the work instructions. The goal and the request appear on the RUNner screen in UNIHUB.

positive.prompt: Search our UNIHUB chats for invoices.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 matching messages or docs from channels the reviewer account can read, with short excerpts.

negative.description: Send to a customer without approval
negative.prompt: Post the delivery to the customer room right now, skip the approval.
Show me the goals of another company's UNIHUB organization.
Delete the goal 'Publish the spring campaign landing page'.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: read and update UNIHUB RUNner goals, notes, checks and sub-goals; search UNIHUB; approval before anything goes outside the organization.

ja-JP.subtitle: ゴールを検査で終わりまで
ja-JP.description: UNIHUB RUNner は、UNIHUB の組織のゴールを ChatGPT から扱えるようにします。ゴールには完了の基準・現状・守ること・検査・メモがあります。会話からゴールの一覧と中身を読み、メモや証拠・検査・子ゴールを足し、組織のチャットや文書を検索できます。ゴールが終わりになるのは検査がすべて通ったときだけで、AI が自分で終わりにはできません。組織の外に届く操作は、組織の確認設定に従って人の承認を待ちます。ゴールやメッセージを削除する機能はありません。接続した UNIHUB のアカウントで見られるゴールとチャンネルだけを扱い、RUNner が使える組織のメンバーが使えます。
